Here is how two of our top home options compare:
• Hotel / Home Safe w/Credit Card Reader & Digital Lock (1.2 Cu. Ft.): Best for everyday convenience, quick digital keypad or card access, and budget-friendly burglary security for small valuables, cash, or electronics.
• 1-Hour Fire/Water Safe w/Digital Combination Lock (0.9 Cu. Ft.): Best for critical paper documents, digital media, and heirlooms where verified 1-hour fire and water protection is your main priority.
If lower cost and daily ease of use matter most, the 1.2 Cu. Ft. model is a great value. If fire and water protection for important records is essential, the 1-Hour Fire/Water safe is the better pick for you.
